mobbin:9f1a536c-16bb-424e-a558-0604130c4.summary: Guest opens End trip with time remaining, documents exterior (and later interior) with photos, reviews host/guest photo sets, accepts liability on Finish checkout, and lands on trip-ended with a timestamp.
steal: Pre-return hub (step 1): countdown ('ends in 2h 30m'), Change trip, Report damage, and End trip that requires a short inspection before checkout.
Photo compliance (steps 2–3): recommended area count + 'View all exterior areas'; Why-it-matters callout; Take photos vs Upload from Photos; Skip allowed.
Shared photo log (step 5): sections by party (host vs guest) with per-photo timestamps before Continue.
Accountability gate (step 7): Finish checkout modal — agree inspection is accurate / liable for unreported damage — then Submit; success shows Trip ended timestamp and notify counterparty.
avoid: Requiring ~15 exterior + ~8 interior photos for every sim-equipment return — scale documentation to high-value assets only.
mobbin:9f1a536c-16bb-424e-a558-0604130c4.fit: Fills the undefined Essentials return/damage path for check-out-manual: condition photos, dual-party evidence, liability confirm, and explicit return timestamp before the item is free again.

mobbin:928e0f27-77e0-456e-b079-4914013cb.summary: From Pickup & return hours, host opens Block availability (empty), sets start/end date-time with calendar and time wheels, and confirms Add for a blocked window.
steal: Empty state (step 2): No hours blocked + Block availability CTA; lightbulb nudge that host unavailability ≠ vehicle unavailability — Go to Calendar to block the asset itself.
Block form (steps 3–6): Start/End date + time fields; inline month calendar; 30-minute time drum; single Add commit.
Recurring vs ad-hoc (step 1): Always available toggle and per-weekday Available hours sit beside Block availability for one-off windows.
mobbin:928e0f27-77e0-456e-b079-4914013cb.fit: Maps to Essentials equipment scheduling / conflict handling (baseline): block a manikin or room for maintenance or exclusive use so two scenarios cannot claim the same asset; keep job as check-out-manual among current ids.
